senses.gloss: f. (= מאתא; אֲתָא; cmp. מָקוֹם; Mand. מאתא; Assyr. mâtu, constr. mât land, v. Schr. KAT2, p. 510; 568) home, place, town.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 85a:3">Men. 85ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>למָת ירקא ירקא שקול</he> Ar. a. Ms. K. (Ms. M. <he>לבית</he>; ed. <he>למתא ירקא</he>) carry vegetables to the home of vegetables; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:13">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>למתא ירקא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 182:4">Yalk. Ex. 182</cite> <he>למ׳ דירקא</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 145b:9">Sabb. 145ᵇ</cite> bot. (prov.) <he>במ׳ שמאי שלא במ׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בלא מ׳</he>) at home my name (will give me my position), abroad, my dress.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b:18">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>בר מ׳ אבר מ׳ מיעבט</he> one citizen may be levied upon for the delinquent taxes of a fellow citizen.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 112a:8">Snh. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>בני מ׳</he> citizens (taxpayers, after a residence of twelve months); <he>יתבי מ׳</he> residents (after thirty-days).
Yeb. 17ᵃ מָאתֵיה, v. הַרְפַּנְיָא; a. v. fr.—Pl. (fr. מתותא, v. P. Sm. 2246) מַתְוָותָא settlements.
<cite ref="Gittin 7a:14">Gitt. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דארעא וכ׳</he> small Palestinian places.
<cite ref="Eruvin 21a:19">Erub. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ מבלען וכ׳</he> (ruined) settlements within a distance of &c.—<he>מתא מחסיא</he>, v. <cite ref="M00910"><he>מְחַסְיָא</he></cite>.
